description: This header defines helper functions for building and configuring various radio access network (RAN) cell and UE configurations, including BWP, CSI, PUCCH, SRS, RLM, PDSCH, PUSCH, and serving cell configurations, based on provided parameters and default settings.

methods.name: make_default_bwp_builder_params
methods.description: Constructs default bandwidth part (BWP) builder parameters based on provided cell configuration parameters.

methods.name: make_default_ran_cell_config
methods.description: Creates a default RAN cell configuration for gNB DU with valid default parameters.

methods.name: make_csi_meas_config_builder_params
methods.description: Builds CSI measurement configuration builder parameters from a given RAN cell configuration.

methods.name: make_csi_meas_config
methods.description: Generates a CSI measurement configuration from a RAN cell configuration.

methods.name: make_pucch_config
methods.description: Constructs a PUCCH configuration based on RAN cell configuration parameters.

methods.name: make_srs_config
methods.description: Builds an SRS configuration from SRS builder parameters and PCI.

methods.name: make_rlm_config
methods.description: Creates a Radio Link Monitoring configuration from RAN cell configuration.

methods.name: make_pdsch_config
methods.description: Builds a PDSCH configuration from RAN cell configuration.

methods.name: make_pusch_config
methods.description: Constructs a PUSCH configuration from PUSCH builder parameters.

methods.name: make_pdsch_serv_cell_config
methods.description: Creates a PDSCH serving cell configuration from PDSCH builder parameters.

methods.name: make_pusch_serv_cell_config
methods.description: Creates a PUSCH serving cell configuration from PUSCH builder parameters.

methods.name: make_ue_serving_cell_config
methods.description: Builds a full UE serving cell configuration from RAN cell configuration and cell index.

methods.name: make_ue_bwp_config
methods.description: Creates a UE BWP configuration mirroring the default serving cell configuration.

methods.name: make_ue_cell_config
methods.description: Creates a UE cell configuration from RAN cell configuration and cell index.
